text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The new year. Hishi Akebono said she had something to give me, so while I was waiting—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Yeeeaaar,
Trai~ner~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She arrived carrying a stack of tiered bento boxes
piled so high they nearly touched the ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for keeping you waiting~.
I just got completely carried away~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's osechi, ozoni, and mochi~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's,
I thought I'd love to have New Year's food with you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what would be good,
but then I thought everything sounded good, so I made it all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's the first day of the year!
We gotta start it off full of energy, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, which one should we eat first~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There are two kinds of osechi: the traditional kind and a modern version~.
It's packed with meat, so it'll give you plenty of energy~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The ozoni is still nice and warm,
so I'm sure it'll warm your tummy right up~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
As for the mochi... we made all kinds of different mochi!
I'm sure it's gonna be super fun~!
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy all kinds of mochi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Osechi? Got it~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, don't be startled now,
here goes~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-daah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a "BAM!" Hishi Akebono popped open the tiered jubako boxes one by one—
until finally, about seventy percent of the lids were off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gorgeous, dazzling assortment of New Year's osechi dishes spread across the entire desk.
It was a hearty, generous feast, true to Hishi Akebono's style.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I really wanted to eat my fill today,
so I worked super hard☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides, osechi keeps for a while,
so it's totally fine if we don't finish it all today~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's dig right in~.
I'll go grab some plates♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's osechi meal Hishi Akebono prepared for us.
It was a huge portion, but every bite was wonderfully buono—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ozoni? Yay! Ehehe, to tell you the truth,
it turned out super buono today~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's soy sauce-based with square-cut mochi~.
Apparently, that's how they make ozoni in Kanto."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, Hishi Akebono opened one of the stacked bento boxes in front of her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Inside were several bowls with ingredients neatly arranged."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Only the carrots are cut into shapes~. A bunny,
a cat, a star, and Trainer-san's shape!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆
It looks pretty similar, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I made it thinking about you smiling, Trainer!
I was even able to finish it without looking at a photo~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the ozoni she made for me
was top-notch in both broth and mochi, and tasted absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Nice. There are lots of kinds
of mochi, so pick whichever you like~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Hishi Akebono opened the tiered bento box,
there was a tight arrangement of colorful mochi packed inside.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made kiri mochi, anko mochi, mugwort mochi, kinako mochi, mitarashi dango, tri-color dango, and even sakura mochi, though it's out of season☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I choose~?
I can't make up my mind~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. We could always split every flavor
in half and share them, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go make some tea for now.
Trainer, I'm borrowing the kettle~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, we ended up splitting everything in half just as suggested... and every single piece of mochi was absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let's do our best together this year,
Trainerâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like we were able to get off
to a great start toward the new year!
